teaser: A napkin covered in half-written lines holds three different sentences, none finished. You are a life path 3, an INTP, and the two rarely arrive at the same pace. The number asks for voice, for color said out loud; the letters work it out in private first, turning a thought over until it holds. What is particular here is a mind that generates far more than it ever performs: a notebook of jokes nobody hears, a theory about why the song works that stays unsaid at rehearsal. The gift and the holdback share a desk.
